primary_endpoint: Liver fibrosis response and treatment-emergent adverse events from baseline to Week 24.
efficacy_outcome: Fibrosis response scores were 0.24, 0.25, and 0.27 for aldafermin 0.3, 1.0, and 3.0 mg, respectively, versus 0.23 for placebo (p=0.5534).
safety_signal: Serious AEs affected 1/43, 4/41, and 1/43 participants in the aldafermin 0.3, 1.0, and 3.0 mg groups, respectively, versus 3/43 with placebo. One death was reported in the 1.0 mg group; none in the other groups.
